photos.alt: Bathroom vanity with a seashell shaped sink, teal soap dispenser, and a mirrored medicine cabinet lit by round vanity bulbs.
A large turquoise swimming pool with entry rails and lounge chairs under green umbrellas beside the condo complex.
Guest bedroom with a queen bed in white linens and navy pillows, vintage nightstands, and plantation shutters.
Two motorboats docked at a wooden pier in front of the three story Tennisplace condominium along a Sanibel canal.
Orange sunset over a calm canal lined with palm trees and docked boats, with purple bougainvillea in the foreground.
Wooden private beach access pathway sign listing Tennis Place and neighboring communities for residents and guests.
Flat screen television on a white woven media console with heron artwork and a recessed beach themed shelf above.
Stone paved outdoor patio with a wooden dining table, green umbrella, park benches, and a stainless steel gas grill.
Two bicycles parked on a wooden canal dock beside green lawn and tropical trees behind the condo.
Golden sunset reflecting across a quiet canal where white boats are docked among palm trees.
Canal view of the beige Tennisplace condominium with pink bougainvillea, a palm tree, and two boats at the dock.
Wide view from the water of Tennisplace condominium buildings, docks, and boats along a Sanibel canal.
Living room with a starfish patterned sectional, glass coffee table, white TV console, and a ceiling fan.
Round wooden dining table with teal rattan chairs opening to a kitchen with white cabinets and stainless appliances.
Bathroom vanity with a cream shell shaped sink, white cabinet doors, and a large mirror under vanity lights.
Turquoise and grey sit on top kayaks resting on a wooden dock overlooking a palm lined canal.
Bedroom with nautical anchor patterned bedding, a white headboard, and a tropical beach painting above the bed.
Nautical bedroom corner with anchor bedding, built in white storage, and a seashell filled lamp on the nightstand.
Bathroom tub and shower combo with sliding frosted glass doors seen through an open doorway.
Bedroom with blue and white striped bedding surrounded by white built in cabinets and a lit geometric nightstand.
Coastal living room with a tan starfish patterned sofa, teal and white pillows, and a large beach painting above.
Round wood dining table with teal cushioned rattan chairs under a woven pendant light beside a mirrored buffet wall.
Brown leather recliner and matching ottoman beside a glass end table with a lit lamp near white vertical blinds.
Black Weber gas grill with stainless side shelves on a stone patio next to a wooden prep table.
Two green hard surface tennis courts behind a chain link fence with tropical trees under a clear blue sky.
Green lawn and purple bougainvillea leading to a canal dock with docked boats and a palm tree.
